definition: the part of a truck where the driver sits
description: Inside the cab of a steam locomotive, a smiling young man in blue overalls, a flat cap and a red neckerchief leans out of the side opening, holding a handle, as steam streams past. He turns back in, reaches down to a brass lever, then leans out again with a grin. Around him are brass gauges, copper pipes, valves and an open firebox glowing orange, with a brass wheel in the foreground. Outside are green hills and a curved stone viaduct, with smoke drifting overhead.

taps.phrase: to lean out of the train

de.answer: Er lehnt sich aus dem Zug.
